---
kind: concept
title: What a change can reach
---

A change's surface is everything a consumer can observe about it, not the lines it edits.

The surface is what someone outside the change can tell has altered: a return
value, an error, an ordering, a timing, a file written, a message sent.

Edited lines are not the surface. A large edit behind an unchanged interface has
a small surface; a one-character edit to a default has a large one.
